auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Intrinio API key sent as a Bearer token. View or create it on your Intrinio account page: https://account.intrinio.com/account/api_keys.

actions.name: get_security_stock_prices
actions.description: Get historical end-of-day stock prices for an Intrinio security.

identifier.description: An Intrinio ID or supported ticker, CIK, LEI, FIGI, ISIN, or CUSIP identifier.

startDate.description: The inclusive start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

endDate.description: The inclusive end date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

frequency.description: The time period represented by each returned stock price.

pageSize.description: The maximum number of records to return.

nextPage.description: The pagination token returned by a previous Intrinio request.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for retrieving historical Intrinio stock prices.

items.description: A historical stock price record returned by Intrinio.

anyOf.description: A security record returned by Intrinio.

security.description: A security record returned by Intrinio.

anyOf.description: The token for the next page, or null at the end.

nextPage.description: The token for the next page, or null at the end.

outputSchema.description: The historical stock prices returned by Intrinio.

actions.name: lookup_company
actions.description: Look up Intrinio company reference data and metadata by identifier.

identifier.description: An Intrinio ID or supported ticker, CIK, LEI, FIGI, ISIN, or CUSIP identifier.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for looking up an Intrinio company.

company.description: A company record returned by Intrinio.

actions.name: lookup_security
actions.description: Look up Intrinio security reference data by identifier.

identifier.description: An Intrinio ID or supported ticker, CIK, LEI, FIGI, ISIN, or CUSIP identifier.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for looking up an Intrinio security.

security.description: A security record returned by Intrinio.

actions.name: search_companies
actions.description: Search Intrinio companies by ticker or company name.

query.description: The ticker or company name text to search for.

active.description: Whether to return only actively traded companies.

mode.description: The matching mode to use for the search query.

pageSize.description: The maximum number of records to return.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for searching Intrinio companies.

items.description: A company record returned by Intrinio.
